$comment: Controlled terminology (AGENTS.md Sections 15, 64, 65). Each entry maps a normalized term to the body-model structures it is ASSOCIATED with (visualizationType: association, never disease). Structure ids are body-model structure or organ-group ids (public/anatomy/body/structures.json). Synonyms are matched case-insensitively after removing punctuation and spaces. Sources: docs/MEDICAL_SOURCES.md.

terms.mappingReason: Creatinine is filtered from the blood by the kidneys, so it is commonly used as a kidney-associated marker.
eGFR estimates how much blood the kidneys filter each minute.
ALT is an enzyme found mainly in the liver, so it is commonly used as a liver-associated marker.
